note: PoW catalog separates verified pool profiles from miner-supported/catalog-only coins. PoS and payout assets are never treated as PoW mining algorithms.

coins.name: Bitcoin
coins.mining_notes: GPU consumer not recommended. NerdMiner is low-hashrate lottery device.

coins.name: Bitcoin Cash
coins.mining_notes: SHA-256 ASIC; merged mining rewards may be available at selected pools.

coins.name: Litecoin
coins.mining_notes: Scrypt ASIC; some pools merge-mine DOGE.

coins.name: Dogecoin
coins.mining_notes: Usually merged-mined with LTC on compatible pools.

coins.name: Monero
coins.mining_notes: NEXUS gates RandomX to CPU; no GPU claims.

coins.name: Ravencoin
coins.mining_notes: GTX 1650 Ti 4GB fails current DAG+runtime margin; NEXUS should block its GPU mining.

coins.name: Ethereum Classic
coins.mining_notes: GTX 1650 Ti 4GB fails current DAG+runtime margin.

coins.name: Kaspa
coins.mining_notes: ASIC-dominated network; GPU compatibility requires miner/version and memory verification.

coins.name: Vertcoin
coins.mining_notes: Dataset around 1.2GB; leave headroom for runtime and display use.

coins.name: Alephium
coins.mining_notes: ASIC and miner support vary; validate exact hardware.

coins.name: Zcash
coins.mining_notes: Equihash variants and miner flags must match the pool.

coins.name: Dash
coins.mining_notes: ASIC-oriented; only use a supported X11 miner.

coins.name: Conflux
coins.mining_notes: Check epoch/DAG memory before selecting a GPU.

coins.name: Nervos Network
coins.mining_notes: ASIC-specific PoW.

coins.name: Nexa
coins.mining_notes: Check supported miner binary and pool before use.

coins.name: Aleo
coins.mining_notes: Specialized proof-generation workload; not interchangeable with SHA/RX.

coins.name: Flux
coins.mining_notes: Equihash-derived algorithm; exact miner flag and VRAM must be validated.

coins.name: Firo
coins.mining_notes: GPU algorithm; confirm current miner support.

coins.name: Ethereum
coins.mining_notes: Ethereum mainnet transitioned to proof-of-stake; do not list it as mineable PoW.

coins.name: Solana
coins.mining_notes: Not a proof-of-work mining asset.

coins.name: EthereumPoW
coins.mining_notes: Separat de Ethereum (ETH); hardware și DAG trebuie verificate.

coins.name: Pearl
coins.mining_notes: Verifică DAG/memorie și compatibilitatea minerului; Kryptex oferă și mod SOLO.

coins.name: Kadena
coins.mining_notes: ASIC specializat; nu GPU consumer.

coins.name: Siacoin
coins.mining_notes: ASIC specializat.

coins.name: Ergo
coins.mining_notes: PoW cun Autolykos2; BzMiner upstream lists support. Pool endpoint neconfigurat în catalogul curent.

coins.name: Xelis
coins.mining_notes: PoW XelisHash; BzMiner upstream lists support. Endpoint unMineable folosit și pentru payout-asset routes.

coins.name: Quantus
coins.mining_notes: PoW Poseidon2; BzMiner/unMiner announced support. Pool extern neconfigurat în acest catalog.

coins.name: Zephyr
coins.mining_notes: PoW RandomX-family; CPU only. Pool profile neconfigurat.

coins.name: Salvium
coins.mining_notes: PoW RandomX-family; CPU only. Pool profile neconfigurat.

coins.name: Verus
coins.mining_notes: PoW VerusHash; BzMiner/Verus miner support list. Pool endpoint neconfigurat.

coins.name: Warthog
coins.mining_notes: PoW Argon2d-family; BzMiner upstream lists support. Exact pool/miner version must be verified.

coins.name: Beam
coins.mining_notes: PoW BeamHash; catalog-only until an active, source-documented pool endpoint is configured.

coins.name: MimbleWimbleCoin
coins.mining_notes: PoW Cuckoo Cycle family; pool and hardware profile not verified in this release.

coins.name: Neurai
coins.mining_notes: KawPoW; miner support listed by BzMiner. Pool endpoint not yet curated.

coins.mining_notes: KawPoW; miner support listed by BzMiner. Pool endpoint not yet curated.
